{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured silk blouse with a tailored collar, relaxed fit through the bodice and long sleeves, midnight blue, 100% mulberry silk.
Wide-leg wool crepe trousers with a sharp front pleat and flat hem, cropped just below the ankle, charcoal grey, virgin wool blend.
Loafers in soft leather with a minimal stacked heel and a perforated toe cap, oxblood red, full-grain calfskin.
A structured tweed blazer worn over the blouse to complete the look, single-breasted with notch lapels, forest green, heavy weight worsted wool.

This outfit works because it perfectly balances professional polish with the comfort needed for an autumn day in the office. The deep midnight blue of the silk top paired with charcoal trousers creates a sophisticated neutral base that feels grounded and serious. A touch of warmth is added by the structured tweed jacket and the rich oxblood loafers, which introduce color without compromising on formality. The relaxed cuts of the silk blouse and wide-leg pants ensure ease of movement while maintaining a refined silhouette suitable for a neat business dress code."}
